articles.title: RLCS REGIONAL 1 MAIN EVENT QUALIFIER
articles.summary: A clutch Game 7 overtime victory against Team BDS secures our starting 3v3 roster a direct spot in the RLCS Europe swiss stage.
content: Following a grueling seven-game series in the final qualifying round, FAZIX locked in their seed for the RLCS Europe Regional 1 Main Event.
After dropping games two and four to heavy defensive counterattacks, captain Zenith converted a backboard ceiling pass from Aura at 2:48 into overtime to close out Champions Field.
The starting roster will now enter a week-long bootcamp at the Fazix training facility in NRW to prepare for Friday’s swiss bracket matches.
articles.author: FAZIX Esports

articles.title: BEHIND THE COMMS: GAME 5 DEFENSIVE HOLD
articles.summary: Coach K4RMA and striker Zenith break down the backboard rotations, boost denial, and comms that held off a 12-shot barrage in overtime.
content: Defense in modern Rocket League is rarely about highlight goal-line saves. It is about closing down shooting lanes before the opponent gets clean contact on the ball.
In this technical replay review, Head Coach K4RMA steps through the team’s communications during the 4-minute overtime hold against Karmine Corp.
By managing small boost pad routes through the midfield, Vortex and Aura maintained third-man coverage without conceding midfield ball control.
articles.author: Coach K4RMA

articles.title: FAZIX RISING: 2026 ACADEMY LINEUP
articles.summary: Welcoming Pulse, Cypher, and Nexus to our developmental squad as they prepare for the weekly European open circuits.
content: FAZIX is pleased to announce our 2026 developmental lineup for Fazix Rising, our official academy team.
Selected from over 140 applicants across the European ladder, Pulse (Denmark), Cypher (Sweden), and Nexus (Italy) will represent Fazix across regional open circuits and ranked 6mans brackets.
The squad will train under academy coach Echo, with direct scrimmage access against our main RLCS team.
articles.author: Fazix Management

articles.title: NRW BOOTCAMP & FACILITY PREP
articles.summary: Two weeks of double practice blocks, tactical reviews with coach K4RMA, and LAN setup rehearsal ahead of the European playoffs.
content: The entire Fazix Rocket League squad has arrived at our team facility in North Rhine-Westphalia for a two-week intensive training camp.
Training focuses on comms pacing under pressure, defensive clears off the backboard, and set-piece kickoffs.
Fans can watch behind-the-scenes vlogs on our YouTube channel throughout the bootcamp.
articles.author: Fazix Media
